# Petals Paradise Events

> Petals Paradise Events is a party rental and event decor company based in Ashburn, Virginia, serving Aldie, South Riding, Chantilly, Sterling, Leesburg, Loudoun County, Fairfax County and the wider DMV (Washington DC metro). We offer full-service event decoration (balloon decor, balloon garlands and arches, floral arrangements, custom backdrops and themed setups) and rent chairs, tables, tents, backdrops, marquee letters, neon signs and South Asian / Indian ceremony decor (Haldi, Mehandi, Seemantham), with delivery, setup and pickup available.

- Phone / text: +1-848-448-6993
- Email: contact@petalsparadiseevents.com
- Hours: Monday–Sunday, 9 AM – 9 PM
- Booking: online at https://petalsparadiseevents.com/#rentals, or by phone/text
- Google reviews: https://g.page/r/CXcHwjVlRTQIEBM/review

## Event decor services

Custom, full-service decoration designed, delivered and set up by our team (priced by quote):

- Balloon decor: balloon garlands, balloon arches, organic balloon walls, balloon columns and themed balloon setups
- Floral decor: floral arrangements, marigold and flower garlands, floral backdrops and staircase drapes
- Custom backdrops and photo walls with signage, drapes and lighting
- Themed tablescapes, centerpieces and dessert / cake table styling
- Indian / South Asian ceremony decor: Haldi, Mehandi, Sangeet, Seemantham, pooja and housewarming (Gruhapravesam) setups
- Graduation decor with school colors, marquee letters and custom backdrops
- Festival decor and lighting for Diwali, Eid, Christmas and other holidays

## Rental categories

- [Chair & Table Rentals](https://petalsparadiseevents.com/rentals/chair-table-rentals.html): folding chairs from $2 ($1.50 each for 30+), rectangular tables $8, round tables $12, cocktail tables, loveseats, accent chairs
- [Tent Rentals](https://petalsparadiseevents.com/rentals/tent-rentals.html): 10x20 tent $100, 16x26 wedding tent $150
- [Backdrop & Photo Prop Rentals](https://petalsparadiseevents.com/rentals/backdrop-rentals.html): event backdrops, pipe & drape stands, Seemantham / baby shower backdrops, newborn photo props
- [Marquee Letters & Neon Signs](https://petalsparadiseevents.com/rentals/marquee-letters-neon-signs.html): 4-ft marquee numbers, GRAD letters, Happy Birthday and Congrats Grad neon signs
- [Haldi, Mehandi & Traditional Decor](https://petalsparadiseevents.com/rentals/haldi-mehandi-indian-decor-rentals.html): Haldi Urli / Maiyan tubs, Haldi backdrop & staircase decor, Mehandi umbrellas, pedestals, centerpieces

Weddings, Haldi and Mehandi ceremonies, Seemantham and baby showers, first birthdays and kids' birthday parties, graduation parties, housewarmings, anniversaries, retirement parties, festival celebrations, corporate and community events.
